scan.title: Scan for secrets
scan.commandDescription: Find credentials typed into requests before you share or commit them
scan.intro: Looks for well-known token formats, random-looking values in credential fields and passwords typed into auth settings. Values written as {{example}} are fine. Nothing leaves this window except the check itself, and only a few characters of a value are ever shown.
scan.cleanDescription: No token formats, random-looking credential values or typed-in passwords were found.
scan.foundShare: These stay in the link or file you create. Replace them with {{example}} first, or share anyway.
scan.foundExport: These are written into the export. Replace them with {{example}} first if the file will be shared or committed.
